title: ZedModelError output
description: Translates the error into a category Zed acts on (for example prompt_too_large, which triggers Zed compaction). Closed: this event has no Claude Code counterpart to stay compatible with.

systemMessage.description: Warning shown to the user as a Zed notification (one per event, cut at 2000 characters), only when the output is accepted; never sent to the model.

hookEventName.description: Must be this event name; a mismatch is a hook failure.

category.description: Category Zed uses instead of its own.

prompt_tokens.description: For prompt_too_large: token count, if the hook knows it.
